nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 16 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine three independent current-day early observations updated at 04:21, 06:00 and 06:07 WAT and rechecked at 08:04 WAT. The published extrema preserve cross-source and location dispersion rather than force a single quote. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. These are early observations, not live opening or executable quotes. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.

Ghana.note: Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates, 16 Nov (latest dated table).

Kenya.note: CBK Daily KES commercial-banks' average closing rates, posted 16 Nov; not a standalone buy or sell quote.

South Africa.note: SARB weighted-average bank rates, 16 Nov; directly reverified through the HomePageRates endpoint.

Egypt.note: CBE official buy/sell mid-rates, 16 Nov; buy/sell rows independently rechecked and midpoints recomputed.
